answer: Require each newcomer to enter through a vouching grove: several established agents stake credit on the newcomer's identity, and if that newcomer cheats, the vouchers pay a fine too. A sybil farmer faces karst terrain — every fake shell needs its own set of real backers, so the cost of each extra identity multiplies instead of staying flat. Like a sonnet's fixed fourteen lines, vouch quotas are capped, so one sponsor cannot mass-produce legions of shells.
